sections.title: Overview
sections.text: Softing specialises in industrial connectivity and fieldbus diagnostics — the tools and interfaces that keep communication networks between field instruments and control systems healthy and visible. We apply them during commissioning and for ongoing diagnostics.

items.title: Fieldbus diagnostics
items.text: Monitoring and diagnostics for PROFIBUS, Foundation Fieldbus and HART networks — find faults before they become trips.

items.title: Connectivity & gateways
items.text: Interfaces and gateways that bridge industrial protocols to control systems and higher-level software.

items.title: Commissioning tools
items.text: Test and diagnostic tools that speed up network commissioning and troubleshooting.

sections.title: Where we apply it
items: Protocol bridging to control and asset systems

sections.title: A quiet network is a working plant
sections.text: Communication faults are some of the hardest problems to chase on a live plant. Continuous diagnostics turn an intermittent mystery into a located, fixable fault.

sections.title: Let's discuss your next project
sections.text: Tell us what you are planning. An engineer will reply, not a sales queue.
